Description Welcome to 'Barefoot Bliss,'  where elegant design meets exquisite Gulf-front location! Located in a highly sought-after Dune Allen Beach community, Barefoot Bliss is a 6-bedroom, 7-bathroom luxury home that sleeps 14 comfortably. With stunning emerald water views from the private pool and direct access to the beach, this home perfectly embodies 30A living! The ground level of this home offers on-site parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway, as well as the convenience of a bathroom and laundry room. Additionally, the laundry room has one set of twin over twin bunk beds. Upon entering this 4-story residence, guests will find a bright great room, aglow with sunshine from the stunning Gulf-front views. An inviting living area offers plush seating around a 75” TV, while a nearby sitting room provides additional comforts with a queen sleeper sofa—ideal for last-minute visitors. Guests can easily prepare cocktails with a wine fridge and ice maker at the wet bar before sitting at the 10-seat dining table for a home-cooked meal. The pristine white kitchen, featuring a stunning marble island with a built-in sink, is fully equipped with high-end Thermador appliances, making it easy to host large groups. Enjoy access to the spacious outdoor deck from anywhere in the great room—swim in the private pool with a built-in sitting spa, relax on 4 cozy loungers, or grill up some snacks in the outdoor kitchen. Guests can use the stairs or in-home elevator to access the top floors of this home. The third floor offers 3 stylish guest bedrooms with great views, each boasting access to a rear balcony overlooking the pool. Just down the hallway is a wet bar with an ice maker and mini-fridge, as well as a stacked washer and dryer for convenience. The fourth floor offers similar accommodations—a wet bar with an ice maker and mini-fridge, as well as another closet with a stacked washer and dryer. There are 2 comfortable guest bedrooms with access to a rear balcony overlooking beautiful Gulf waters. Both the third and fourth floor wet bars are stocked with a Keurig machine for the early risers! This beachfront property provides incredible amenities and spectacular views, as well as being a prime location for exploring local shops and restaurants. With 8 adult bikes—plus a 6-passenger golf cart—getting around has never been easier. Experience the ultimate relaxation and convenience at Barefoot Bliss!  HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Steps from the beach -Gulf front with spectacular views  -Private pool with Sitting Spa **Pool heating available for $50 per day** -Complimentary beach setups each morning include 8 beach chairs with 4 umbrellas (Mar 1 2025-Feb 28 2026) -6 Passenger golf cart -8 adult bikes -Elevator -Travel Crib and highchair provided -One step from the sand from back door PARKING: Four driveway parking spaces available. No garage access. Included is a 6 seater golf cart and 8 bicycles (adult) for your convenience. To drive golf cart, you must be: 25 years old, sign a liability waiver, and have valid insurance and drivers license. Golf Cart is included as an amenity, at no additional cost.
